ValidationRule.description: ROSA checklist: steps 1 to 6 are done in order (Robert, 2026-11-26). Implementation steps 7a to 7d can be done in any order.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ROSA_Deal_Checklist' && ((ROSA_Step_2_Done__c && NOT(ROSA_Step_1_Done__c)) || (ROSA_Step_3_Done__c && NOT(ROSA_Step_2_Done__c)) || (ROSA_Step_4_Done__c && NOT(ROSA_Step_3_Done__c)) || (ROSA_Step_5_Done__c && NOT(ROSA_Step_4_Done__c)) || (ROSA_Step_6_Done__c && NOT(ROSA_Step_5_Done__c)))
